details.metric_about: Peak concurrently sampled process-tree RSS, Margin plus Git children

sampling.boundary: a kernel-accounted quantity of the session's process tree, not a wall latency: VmHWM, the concurrent tree sum, or utime+stime
sampling.cache_method: one fresh surface session per run on a 120-column, 40-row xterm-256color pseudo-terminal, driven with --reduced-updates through the fixed open/review/history sequence
sampling.order_rule: one recorded-seed coin flip per block decides baseline/candidate order

statistics.method: nearest-rank over MiB values; every counted run retained; the gate is the maximum sample against the ceiling

details.memory_definition: peak of the concurrent sum of VmRSS over the process tree rooted at the surface parent (Margin plus every Git child, found through PPid links in /proc/*/stat), sampled every 20 ms across launch, the fixed sequence, and quit, in MiB; a per-process maximum or a child's lone peak is a different statistic (SPEC 17.5)
notes: every session drove the fixed sequence: the useful Read frame, the Changes view, the History view, back to Read, one j/k reading pair, then quit
